tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Keyword search over the Agent402 catalog of 500+ tools (0 loaded by this server). Returns matching tools and workflow templates; run one with catalog.call. Pure-CPU tools are free through proof-of-work; the others are paid per call in USDC when a wallet key is set.

query.description: What you need, e.g. "search the web for x402", "answer a question with citations", "convert miles to km"

tools.name: catalog.find
tools.description: Resolve a plain-language task to the single best-matching Agent402 tool through the hosted /api/find resolver. Returns { task, matches } with the top pick first. Run the pick with catalog.call and the slug and params it lists. Use catalog.search to compare several candidates.

task.description: What you want to do, e.g. "search the web for x402 adoption" or "convert miles to km"

annotations.title: Resolve a task to the one best Agent402 tool

tools.name: catalog.call
tools.description: Call any Agent402 tool by slug (find slugs with catalog.find or catalog.search). Payment is handled automatically: USDC via x402 if this server has a wallet key, otherwise free proof-of-work on eligible pure-CPU tools (no wallet needed). Wallet-keyed highlights: live search/answer, stock-quote, render, transcribe, memory, and the /v1 LLM gateway tiers.

slug.description: Tool slug from catalog.search, e.g. "search" or "unit-convert"

params.description: Tool input parameters, matching the tool's inputSchema

tools.name: payment.info
tools.description: How this MCP server is paying for Agent402 calls (USDC wallet vs proof-of-work), and what that unlocks. Includes Claude Code / Cursor / npm install one-liners.

tools.name: server.describe
tools.description: Describe this stdio MCP server: the tools it lists, install commands, free vs paid, and discovery URLs.

instructions:
Agent402 is the applied layer of Agentic Finance: a catalog of 500+ tools for AI agents: per-call tools and metered models, paid in USDC over x402 or MPP, or free through proof-of-work for the pure-CPU tools.
Flagship tools: web.search (live web search), web.answer (answers with citations), web.news, browser.render, market.quote, audio.transcribe, memory.read, memory.write.
Long tail: catalog.search lists tools by keyword, catalog.find returns the best match with its input schema and price, catalog.call runs a tool by slug.
Also: server.describe (connector details), payment.info (wallet and payment setup), demand.request (report a missing tool).
Install (npm package, pinned): claude mcp add agent402 -s user -- npx -y agent402-mcp@0.13.20
Hosted connector (proof-of-work tools free; others need a wallet on the npm package): claude mcp add --transport http agent402 https://agent402.tools/mcp
